verified: Memory changed after explicit permission and exact preview is refused before provider generation.
Fresh review first reconciles the original delivery ID and durably closes it without provider contact.
Old delayed or retried request IDs cannot send after closure; an active delivery settles under the existing conversation lock.
A completed receipt is recovered/published before offering a new attempt; a completed turn with no receipt blocks new generation.
Failed/stopped/crashed attempts with no receipt are disclosed as indeterminate; a new attempt needs explicit fresh review.
Recovered questions can be edited, cancelling retains them, and restart requires new Ask first permission.
Original Character/chapter scene targets, Storyline scope and replacement history boundary are retained; separate composer question and picker stay unchanged during review.
Fresh send uses new delivery and turn IDs and a current fingerprint. Final provenance contains current permitted facts and omits private notes.
Rendered Stop delegates to the existing request-specific interruption API and retains the stopped recovered question without another send.
Journal and reconciliation failures keep sending closed and preserve original identity for safe repeated reconciliation.
independent_review: Release agent found no material completed-turn duplication, delayed-old-ID race, permission reuse or stale scope adoption; ran core8/8 and session/rendered14/14.
limits: Browser transport adapter launches a fresh stdio process per request; native persistent-process interruption is not covered by these browser journeys.
Indeterminate remote attempts cannot establish whether a provider processed or charged for an unsaved result; the author receives an explicit notice before authorizing another attempt.

full_suite_isolation.observed_failure: 405 passed, 1 failed: replacement boundary assertion received preceding completed-id instead of replacement-turn
full_suite_isolation.cause: Absence of Retry was used as a completion signal, but Retry is also hidden while reconciliation is running. The preceding test could reset its shared transport harness before the old asynchronous request settled.
full_suite_isolation.deterministic_probe: A held reconciliation proves Retry absent while original pending identity and reconciling=true remain. Release is followed by completed notice, journal removal and pending=null assertions.
full_suite_isolation.repair: Wait for actual settled state, and drain the book/thread delivery session in afterEach before runtime and harness cleanup. Keep exact replacement ID/history assertions.
